findings.issue: The `Category` (175-178), `Preadditive` (212-215) and `Linear ℚ` (217-220) instances, plus `hom_ext` (182-184), `id_toRatLinearMap` (188-190) and `comp_toRatLinearMap` (194-197), are verbatim copies of `MixedHodgeStructureCat`'s (Mixed/Category.lean:99-102, 140-143, 145-148, 106-108, 112-114, 118-121) with `X.hs` replaced by `X.asMixed.hs`. summary: No pre-existing polarizable/pure Hodge category exists, so the object is new material, but the categorical scaffolding is copied verbatim from `MixedHodgeStructureCat` instead of obtained from Mathlib's `InducedCategory` combinator, and the realization lemmas add HEq/eqToHom transport where the mixed file's `@[expose]` pattern gives the same statements by `rfl`.
